Common definitions (details in `PREANALYSIS.md`): conclusion = ordered model pair (a above b) in the BT-MLE leaderboard (pair-aggregated counts, ties as half a win, ridge 1e-4). `k_upper` = smallest number of altered comparisons found by search whose exact refit puts b at or above a (a verified upper bound on the minimum; `k_lower` only where an exact/LP anchor exists). `perturbation` = `delete` (remove comparisons) or `flip` (change outcomes, non-dominated types). `z` = gap / bootstrap SE (cluster bootstrap by battle / question / game, B in `n_boot`), `z_fisher` = gap / model-based SE. `F = k_upper * g_max / SE_boot`, `Q = F / z_boot`. `Q_null`, `k_null_*` = same-graph parametric-bootstrap replicates (same pairs and counts, fitted scores, tie rate; 20 replicates) at the pair's `z_fisher`. `k_null_pred = Q_null * gap / g_max` is the k* the null predicts for this very pair without searching on the real data; `k_upper / k_null_pred = Q / Q_null`.

# Review of the final version (paper-repo#18) at d890ddd: approved

Built document: `document/main`, built-from d890ddd22df2, 29 pages. The main text ends on page 9, checklist included.

Changes since the approved 365e0e8: the Arena-55k positive-control cells (Table 5, Fig. 6, Appendix C text) and the renumbering of later appendix tables.

Checked against `results/positive_control.csv` (68 rows, 34 per graph, `detected` False in all):
- Table 5 values and the "−0.014 to 0.078" range match the file.
- The no-departure flip offset 0.045, the overdispersion 2 and position bias 2 shifts (deletion 0.024–0.028, flip 0.064–0.067) and the SE ratios 0.82/0.94/0.87 match the file.

- The cross-references (Tables 5–7) are consistent. Fig. 6 is described as complete and the "incomplete" label is gone.
- The `results/README.md` status line is now true.

Objective items: paper in NeurIPS format with the checklist, abstract through limitations, reproduction instructions and a per-table/figure script mapping (REPRODUCE.md), no use of the forbidden paper (Appendix A discloses the unread starter item and the two incidentally seen abstracts), and the unfinished work stated honestly.

Not held against the paper (`may`): Section 4 could lead with the informative results (Δ now reads as expected-by-identity; the interval ratio and survival results are the informative ones).

I approved the final version, `paper-repo`#18 at head `d890ddd`, so it can now merge into `final`. The pull request's checks were still pending when I approved, and I did not wait for them.

- **Positive control:** the new Arena-55k cells (Table 5, Fig. 6, Appendix C text) match the complete `positive_control.csv`. That file has 68 rows, 34 per graph, and none is detected. The Arena interval range in the text, −0.014 to 0.078, is the file's. The no-departure flip offset (0.045), the overdispersion and position-bias shifts, and the SE ratios also match.
- **Wording:** the paper says what the Arena control cannot see: overdispersion injected per block of 20 comparisons acts almost like noise there. The earlier "incomplete" label is gone from the figure caption.
- **Other checks:** the table cross-references are consistent after the renumbering, and the `results/README.md` status line is now true. The built document is 29 pages, with the main text ending on page 9, checklist included.

One `may` is left open: Section 4 could lead with the informative results. The record is in `reviews/final-d890ddd.md`.
